text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pituitary Macroadenoma (likely non-functioning or prolactinoma) causing bitemporal hemianopsia and secondary hypercortisolism. The elevated cortisol combined with bitemporal hemianopsia strongly suggests a pituitary mass compressing the optic chiasm and driving adrenal hyperplasia, rather than primary adrenal disease.
